name: wfo_dca_grid_hpo
_doc: HPO cho DCA grid + exit giveback (2026-08-01). Mo DCA_GRID_SCALAR=true => Configs sinh luoi tu 4 so vo huong va StrategyWfoTask HOAN DOI genome 17 -> 21 gene (bo DCA_LOSS/TIME_BIG_DOWN va TS_MAX_GAP/WEAK/WEAK_THRES vi chung CHET duoi 2 co nay; them 5 gene grid + 2 gene tran bac + TS_MIN_GAP/TS_GIVEBACK_RATIO). Nguon cau hinh: configs/exit_dca_20260801_hpo.env. CHU Y: step verify_stage la GATE BAT BUOC — jar stale da lam mat 2 vong do trong phien 2026-08-01, ca 2 lan deu im lang. RAM: 2 Oracle worker x 3G = 6G, box 23G => an toan; KHONG nang oracle_workers ma khong do free -g truoc.

steps._doc: GATE: jar da stage phai chua DU token scalar. Thieu => HPO quay gene ma khong doi gi => ket qua GIA. Chay 'ce.sh verify_stage' truoc de day script len /home/ubuntu/claudedata/.run/.
KHONG launch batch moi khi batch cu chua ALL_DONE (luat rut ra tu su co treo box 2026-08-01: 3 batch chong nhau = 12 JVM x 3G = 36G > RAM).
